prompt:
Create ONE finished 16:9 main-menu screen for the original 2D combat game DON'T ERASE ME. This is a SIMPLE, MATURE, RESTRAINED game menu using the newly approved hybrid visual language: PIXEL-ART PLAYER AND WEAPON inside a CONTINUOUS FINE-LINE MONOCHROME environment. Use the supplied image as a style and character reference, NOT as the menu composition. Do not reproduce its vertical divider or magnified character panel.

VISUAL TONE:
Quiet tension, purposeful, austere, adult. Warm near-white paper #faf9f5, charcoal #232220 and restrained grays. Strong composition and ample space. No cute or cheerful cartoon styling, no anime faces, no big eyes, no smiling icons, no rounded toy proportions, no doodled stars or hearts. No dense environment, no painterly art, no 3D rendering, gradients, dramatic light, bloom or photographic texture. Keep more than 60% of the screen calm and visually empty.

LAYOUT:
The title and small illustrated scene share a left alignment. Title occupies the upper-left, a single compact illustration group occupies the lower-left, and the right third holds four spacious aligned buttons. The center is clean open paper. This is a cohesive finished game menu, not a comparison sheet, website, poster, wireframe or a screen in a device.

TITLE:
Exact title: "DON'T ERASE ME", preferably arranged as "DON'T" over "ERASE ME".
Sober narrow uppercase lettering with deliberate medium-weight dark ink strokes, sharp terminals and modest hand-printed imperfections. Strong readable title with controlled spacing. Avoid whimsical thin wandering handwritten letters, bubbly lettering, oversized distressed brush lettering, cartoon typography and elaborate gothic type. No subtitle, flourish text or tagline.

ILLUSTRATION GROUP, LOWER LEFT:
Only a short partial broken low wall and a handful of irregular pale-gray paving outlines near the left and lower edges, drawn in quiet, slightly imperfect FINE CONTINUOUS PEN LINES. No courtyard, trees, gardens, studios, easels, furniture, paint supplies or panoramic ruins. The environment should fade into clean whitespace through fewer lines, not a blur or glow. No large black foreground silhouette.
ONE SMALL PIXEL COLLECTOR in the same simple style as the reference: dark short hair, blank pale face patch with no facial features, high-collared charcoal short coat, small gray portfolio at the back, compact connected arms and legs. Readable mature human proportions, no giant head, no chibi body. Approximate displayed height 100 pixels on a 1920x1080-equivalent canvas, so he is a small game character, NOT a huge detailed illustration. Clear stepped square pixel clusters, four or five gray values, no smooth high-resolution face. He holds or has just beside him a compact pixel firearm pointing right, with an obvious barrel, muzzle and receiver. No stationery. Keep all weapon rendering pixelated to match him.
Across a modest stretch of empty ground to his right is ONE low horizontal eraser beast, height about 60% of the player and wider than tall. Its style stays NON-PIXEL fine linework: opaque pale-gray eraser body, dark paper sleeve around rear, jagged black bite opening at the front, tiny tucked hooks. No cute eyes, no smile, no long legs. A low predatory shape, not a big boss. Player and enemy are separated, suggesting a tense encounter rather than friendly mascots posing together. Do not pixelate the monster or background.
One very small broken charcoal ink trail on the ground subtly evokes drawing and erasing. No colored rainbow paint, no particle shower, no explosion, no muzzle flash. Keep the scene subordinate to the title and menu.

MENU, RIGHT THIRD:
EXACTLY FOUR identical large, square-corner rectangular buttons in one vertical column, equal width, equal generous spacing. Fine charcoal outline with very slight natural pen variation, clean off-white fill, no gritty decoration. Clear restrained medium-weight simplified Chinese typography, ample padding, center aligned.
Exact text, top to bottom:
"开始游戏"
"守卫模式"
"画画模式"
"画廊"
The first is selected using a SMALL dark triangular marker beside the label or just outside its left edge, and a subtle gray fill. No multiple arrows or extra icons.
One small outlined GEAR icon positioned separately at bottom right as settings, no text label and no extra menu item. Gear is simple, functional, restrained, not an emoji.

STRICT WHITELIST:
The ONLY words anywhere are "DON'T ERASE ME", "开始游戏", "守卫模式", "画画模式", "画廊", each once. No other text, letters, numbers, version, instructions, captions, settings label, artist signature, watermark, footer, corner branding, small props writing or explanatory labels. No visible browser controls.

Deliver a polished minimal main-menu image with readable typography and actual game-like visual restraint. The tension should come from posture, spacing and monochrome shapes, not complexity or decorative darkness.
